TITLE: AI Engineering Intern
COMPANY: MetAntz
LOCATION: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

MetAntz connects the top talents with global opportunities. This is an exciting internship opportunity with one of our customers, a leading FX Trading platform provider.
 About The Role
 Join the Customer Engineering team at a fast-growing global fintech company that builds technology powering the world's financial markets. You will sit close to real customers, learn a serious enterprise platform end to end, and use AI to make support faster and smarter. This is a rare chance to start your career solving real problems for real users, not shadowing from the sidelines. If you love building, automating, and figuring things out, you will fit right in.
 What You Will Do
Learn The Platform: Go deep on how our product works and become someone customers can rely on.
Support Customers: Help customers resolve issues, answer technical questions, and make their experience smooth.
Build Automations: Use AI and scripting to automate repetitive support tasks and speed up resolutions.
Work Cross-Functionally: Partner with engineering and product to turn customer feedback into fixes and improvements.
Ship And Learn: Take ownership of small projects from day one and grow fast.
 Who You Are
Education: CS or IT graduate passing out in 2026 or 2027.
Availability: 2026 grads can join now. 2027 grads can join now or in January 2027.
AI Knowledge: Hands-on familiarity with AI tools, prompting, or building simple AI-powered solutions.
Technical Base: Solid computer science and programming fundamentals and comfort with scripting or automation.
Mindset: Curious, customer-first, and quick to learn. You enjoy solving problems and explaining them clearly.
Communication: Top-notch communication skills to engage with customers.
 Why Join?
Real Impact: Work directly with customers on a platform used across financial markets.
AI-First Work: Build with the tools defining the future of software and support.
Mentorship: Learn from an experienced engineering team that invests in you.
Growth Path: Strong interns have a clear route to a full-time offer.
Early Ownership: Real responsibility from week one, not busywork.
 Details
Type: Internship - 4-6 months. Good performance during the internship will lead to a full-time offer. 7 Lakhs+ annual salary.
Stipend: 30000/month
Start: Immediate or January 2027
